project: CE 393 Plate No. 2 - Proposed Two-Storey Residential Building
assumptions: The adjusted Phase 1 traverse is an academic plotting basis, not cadastral certification.

For this student activity, the selected academic setback basis is a uniform 2.00 m inward offset on all five lot boundaries using the general Group A dwelling baseline in PD 1096 Section 708(a). This is an explicit classroom assumption, not a real construction/permit determination.
Ground finished-floor elevation is ±0.000 m and second finished-floor elevation is +3.000 m, matching the Phase 4 assumed rise; both require instructor confirmation.

The 9.30 m x 7.90 m rectangular house is the adopted academic footprint (73.47 m2); use the same outer envelope for both preliminary floor-area calculations unless the final second-floor plan is changed.
Adopt one off-street parking space in the 2.80 m x 5.50 m carport for the student plate; this is an academic design assumption.
Doors, windows, finishes, ceiling/eaves/roof levels and roof pitch are draft design targets, not confirmed code minima.
No structural member sizing, reinforcement, foundation design, detailed utilities, permit compliance or construction instruction is included.

Include a required second-floor balcony 3.00 m wide x 1.50 m projection (4.50 m2), attached to and accessed from the master bedroom on the upper edge of the A-03 plan. Count it separately from enclosed house floor area.
